description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, proudly Canadian since 2005, with 385+ locations nationwide. This Westbank location serves fully customizable Mexican-inspired burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas built from fresh, in-house ingredients with a wide variety of proteins. It is a convenient quick-service stop for cyclists passing through the Westbank commercial corridor near Kelowna.
